items.q: How much does it cost to install an EV charger at home?
items.a: It depends on the distance from your panel, the charger you choose and whether your panel has capacity. We give you a free quote before any work starts.

items.q: Can I install a Level 2 charger at home?
items.a: In most homes, yes. We check your panel and the circuit it needs, and tell you if an upgrade is required first.

items.q: Do I need a panel upgrade for an EV charger?
items.a: Not always. A Level 2 charger needs a dedicated circuit, so if your panel is full or undersized we will recommend the right option.

items.q: Do you install chargers for businesses?
items.a: Yes. We install EV charging for residential and commercial properties.
